text.es: Marta: Pensaba que te perdía. Fina: No me vas a perder, loca. Estoy perdidita por tus huesos. Marta: Entonces, si seguimos siendo novias... ¿no vas a poner una foto mía en la pared?
text.en: Marta: I thought I was losing you. Fina: You're not going to lose me, you crazy thing. I'm head over heels for you. Marta: So, if we're still girlfriends... aren't you going to put a photo of me on the wall?
